question: Can a deterministic scalar physical-transport residual observer turn the already-metered CP1536 host into a raw-MSE-below-1e-7 estimator while remaining below the Phase-2 0.1 score-floor compute threshold?

parent_evidence.local_student_interpretation: The prior negative student had no weight-matrix transport and therefore did not test a physical recurrent correction.

data.selection_policy: No architecture, width, random map, ridge, clip, fold, checkpoint, or threshold is selected from CV results.

architecture.name: CP1536 scalar physical-transport fixed-random-feature observer
architecture.local_input: depth coordinate plus the 19 standardized CP1536 target-blind raw-local columns
architecture.recurrent_input: cdf_l * (correction_(l-1) @ W_l), divided by sigma_l and clipped to [-8,8]
architecture.random_map: per-layer PCG64 seed 1592654542 + layer; iid normal weights with std 0.45 and iid uniform[-1,1] biases; tanh activation
architecture.readout: per-layer ridge on intercept, 21 direct inputs, and 128 fixed tanh features
architecture.training_transport: teacher-forced with the true previous-layer CP1536 residual
architecture.deployment_transport: autonomous with the observer's previous predicted correction

metrics.primary: network-weighted four-fold out-of-fold autonomous final-layer raw MSE over all 688*1024 held entries
metrics.capacity_diagnostic: network-weighted four-fold out-of-fold teacher-forced final-layer raw MSE
baselines: out-of-fold CP1536 host final-layer raw MSE
per-layer host, teacher-forced, and autonomous raw MSE
per-fold and per-network final-layer raw MSE
metrics.finite_guard: every complete autonomous and teacher-forced trajectory must be finite

decision_gates.fatal_finite: all 688 out-of-fold autonomous trajectories are finite
decision_gates.promotion: If primary passes, freeze the fold evidence and build/literally meter a single deployable all-688 fit of this exact architecture before any board submission.
decision_gates.teacher_only: If capacity passes but primary fails, close this exact teacher-trained autonomous spelling and promote exposure-trained recurrent fitting as the concrete successor.
decision_gates.failure: If capacity fails, close this exact scalar fixed-random-feature form; do not close the broader already-metered H128/P4 recurrent observer.

projected_deployment_flops.status: target-independent conservative static projection; literal FlopScope meter required only after an accuracy pass

resource_bound.execution_priority: nice +10 while the primary full-688 autonomous-state CV is live

scope_boundary: This is a protected observer_fit cross-validation discriminator, not a literal deployment meter, observer_selection result, board estimate, or proof about every cheap deterministic architecture.
